claim: LP alone and both start pipelines attain target in every repeat on the same 54 of 72 cases.
assumptions: Synthetic panel; two-second timestamp gate; three repeats and all-repeat target.
falsifier: Find an admissible raw-LP failure or a grouped/repaired all-repeat target success on one of the remaining forced cases.

claim: Group start has no practical two-second advantage over LP-informed repair: forced cases 0 better, 11 ties, 7 worse.
assumptions: Prespecified 0.1% fallback-scale effect; case-median feasible costs, comparison within model.
falsifier: At matched budget, obtain increased all-repeat target attainment or a practical paired median improvement over repair and direct MILP.

claim: Five forced 12x16 case wins over direct full MILP coexist with losses against repair on all six cases of that size.
assumptions: Post-hoc size disaggregation of prospectively fixed 2-second paired endpoint; six cases only.
falsifier: Recompute case-specific practical differences from raw trajectories and input fallback scales.

claim: The full solver confirmed all 54 grouped-arm starts and 53 repair-arm starts; 31 and 37 were nonfallback respectively.
assumptions: Numeric HiGHS 1.12 start objective matched prior validated witness and full original model enforced.
falsifier: Find an incompatible restored full matrix vector or objective mismatch beyond 2e-5.

claim: All 18 forced root restrictions were declared infeasible by isolated presolve and the common original fallback passed in all cases.
assumptions: HiGHS presolve status is numerical; forced synthetic construction.
falsifier: Exhibit a physically feasible single-mode solution on one of these exact forced instances.

claim: Fresh W03 repeat recovered the 20/24 full/adaptive/LP-repair target counts and raw LP 18/24; endpoint costs varied against historical traces.
assumptions: Unmodified W03 generation and code; original reviewer fixed-clock tolerance; separate replay on shared host.
falsifier: Recompute all-repeat counts or recorded fixed-clock comparisons from the original and fresh W03 archives.

claim: Independent schedule replay agreed on 3019 retained witnesses and calculated 72 exact model LP box bounds.
assumptions: Binary64 coefficient model, direct dispatch tolerances; full MIP dual bounds are numerical.
falsifier: Find classification disagreement or an accepted primal cost below its exact LP bound beyond tolerance.

claim: All feasible cost thresholds are equivalent
assumptions: Cost-nonincreasing maps in both directions on feasible types. May have empty domains and requires no attainment or bijection
falsifier: Construct a threshold witness on one side with both map inequalities satisfied and no witness on the other.

claim: A single reconstructed reduced minimizer certifies a full minimizer
assumptions: Global projection plus one attained minimizer with a cost-checked feasible lift. No guarantee for another reduced optimizer
falsifier: Produce a projected point below the attained reduced minimum or a lifted point violating the stated equality while keeping all hypotheses.

claim: Real infima satisfy the asymmetric additive sandwich
assumptions: Both domains nonempty and bounded below plus global cost maps. Does not imply boundary attainment
falsifier: Produce a feasible cost strictly outside either bound while validating both global transfer inequalities.

claim: A returned feasible candidate has regret at most alpha+beta+epsilon
assumptions: Uniform projection plus reduced-suboptimality certificate and checked returned lift. No global lift follows from empirical coverage
falsifier: Exhibit a validated candidate exceeding the summed error while meeting its reduced suboptimality and transfer inequalities.

claim: Nested feasible sublevels expand and retained cost does not rise
assumptions: True set inclusion and validated fallback with common full objective. An individual solver return can worsen
falsifier: Exhibit a witness lost under a genuine inclusion or a higher returned cost under the defined retain function.

claim: An unrestricted lower bound and feasible incumbent certify an absolute gap
assumptions: Bound valid for every full feasible point. Restricted bound cannot generally certify gap
falsifier: Produce an overrun of U minus L as a regret bound with a truly global L and feasible U.

claim: The W03 homogeneous ideal-storage class instantiates the two cost maps
assumptions: Positive N and balanced labels and common integer rate/capacity and aggregate-only external terms. No generalization to unequal parameters
falsifier: Exhibit an ideal storage instance satisfying every published endpoint and rate hypothesis for which the constructed lift violates feasibility or cost.

claim: Removing specific premises admits constructive failures
assumptions: Concrete finite labelled or rational controls. Controls concern explicit model variants
falsifier: Invalidate a specific finite counterexample or independently verify the corresponding false universal statement.

claim: Three-term regret can be sharp
assumptions: Abstract cost inequalities and two points in each domain. Elementary example with no novelty or solver-speed claim
falsifier: Show either transfer inequality fails or the two-point family fails to reach equality for some nonnegative triple.

claim: Finite rational audit found 2592 passing candidate bounds
assumptions: Only the exact finite grids specified in code. Shared cases with no field sampling
falsifier: An independent enumeration detects a failed inequality or a different count on the same finite grids.

claim: All 72 native W03 trajectories matched their archived hourly actions.
assumptions: Original frozen W03 inputs; the wall gate can vary.
falsifier: Any rerun action difference under the original deadline pattern.

status: mechanism reproduced on one historical case
claim: At hour index 11 on outage_reserve_864 distinct first actions achieved identical optimal forecast service and throughput. Substituting the archived Linux action reproduced its entire trajectory.
assumptions: Two-stage W03 LP; supplied Linux trajectory; same original issued forecasts.
falsifier: Either conditioned first-action optimum differs or Linux substitution fails to recover later actions.

claim: value6 minus none6, all: -11.430 MWh/day, descriptive day-cluster 95% interval [-15.899, -7.175].
assumptions: Three regimes nested in each of 24 fresh days; same H6 forecasts, physical set and tie breaking. Internal replay.
falsifier: Mean gain fails 0.1 MWh/day gate, interval includes zero or any accepted action violates tolerance.

claim: value6 minus rule6, all: -5.034 MWh/day, descriptive day-cluster 95% interval [-8.208, -1.972].
assumptions: All 24 complete latent days; strong matched rule; includes deadlines. Conversion loss and throughput increase.
falsifier: Mean gain fails 0.1 MWh/day gate, interval includes zero or any accepted action violates tolerance.

claim: value6 minus rule6, outage_reserve: +0.477 MWh/day, descriptive day-cluster 95% interval [-0.309, +1.365].
assumptions: Scheduled reserve and outage can share a visible event window; physically unavailable reserve is counted.
falsifier: A prespecified new independently generated outage panel with a material negative interval would support an outage benefit.

claim: value12 minus rule12, all: +13.078 MWh/day, descriptive day-cluster 95% interval [+10.056, +16.633].
assumptions: Same 12-hour issue and same hard constraints. Identical terminal estimator across H arms.
falsifier: Material, validated service reduction against the H12 forecast rule.

claim: value12 minus value12_tail6, all: +8.344 MWh/day, descriptive day-cluster 95% interval [+6.146, +10.493].
assumptions: Both H12; sixth load issue held flat in control. No extra outage information. Flat alternative is only one imputation.
falsifier: Different effects under alternative tail imputations, different days or controllers limit transfer.

claim: All 20736 primary actions passed independent replay; maximum residual 7.105e-14. 21 actions used fallback.
assumptions: Synthetic grid cap, rate, reserve, efficiency, facility, SOC and terminal constraints; tolerance 1e-6.
falsifier: Any recomputed violation above tolerance or accepted trajectory below the offline lower objective.

claim: Live passes matched 859/864 trajectories exactly. 0 of 5 differing trajectories remained unequal after forcing original observed deadline signals.
assumptions: Same host, solver, data, code. Forced clock is a diagnostic. On-time asynchronous fallback delivery untested.
falsifier: Any differences surviving fixed deadline signals or independent cross-platform discrepancy.

claim: Plant performance, independent W04 Linux replication, real-time fallback actuation and jobs/degradation economics remain open.
assumptions: No operational trace, physical plant, contractual economic model or independent W04 operating-system run.
falsifier: Independent real-world data and timing instrumentation would be needed for these outcomes.

claim: All 160 saved terminal vectors passed the independent AC checks. 147 passed by 12 seconds. All 147 on-time objectives agree with the rounded PGLib baseline to its printed precision.
assumptions: Four public normal/API pairs and five repeats per arm. Implemented common static model and stated tolerances.
falsifier: Independent two-ended flow calculation violates a stated constraint or a published-objective difference exceeds its rounding interval.

claim: Neither all-pivot nor degree-based elimination achieved the frozen 10 percent reduction in median paired elapsed time against either full start on any case.
assumptions: Only jointly on-time same-repeat pairs within 1e-5 relative cost are compared. Shared host and early-case load imbalance.
falsifier: A same-clock matched case shows a prespecified median ratio at or below 0.90.

claim: At 1354 typical all-pivot removes 520 variables while added lower-factor fill increases from 99221 to 107615.
assumptions: RCM order and explicit KKT graph. No native IPOPT factor timing measurement. All chosen generation costs are affine.
falsifier: Graph replay under the named ordering yields a different entry count.

claim: The frozen reduced-arm initial box metadata uses the unreconstructed generator guess. Full matched controls all-pivot only.
assumptions: Raw initial physical point before solver bound pushing. Final feasibility independently verified.
falsifier: Direct substitution agrees with the original reduced-arm initial violation on all cases.

claim: Global redundancy of the additional absolute angle box remains unproved on the 300- and 1354-bus networks.
assumptions: Conditional exact lift holds between the common implemented formulations. All retained terminal angles are inside the box.
falsifier: A proof derives the box from original case constraints or exhibits a feasible excluded point.

claim: 20 of 24 primary attempts hit the supervisor guard and 18 ended before the first worker checkpoint. One grouped-arm schedule and no confirmed grouped transfers.
assumptions: Two process lanes on a shared arm64 host. No feasible common fallback.
falsifier: A missing before-deadline canonical witness or a feasible grouped-start acknowledgement changes these counts.

claim: All four policies had a validated schedule in five of six cells on the serial replay. Group and LP repair each had four confirmed nonfallback starts.
assumptions: Longer import allowance and one UC worker. Identical 45-second numerical policy and three dates with dependent horizon pairs.
falsifier: A start objective lacks solver acknowledgement or its pre-transfer schedule fails the canonical checks.

claim: Group cost exceeded LP repair in all five matched serial cases. Three losses exceeded 0.1 percent. One practical direct-MILP win occurred on January RTS 48h.
assumptions: One trial per date/horizon/arm. Costs and ratios only compared within a case.
falsifier: A grouped schedule beats LP repair at the same deadline and prespecified practical threshold.

claim: 357 eligible full-model numerical lower updates were consistent with their best available feasible upper cost. One of 358 had no comparable upper.
assumptions: Full-model MIP solver duals and discounted optimal outer LP objectives. Consistency alone cannot certify a numerical lower bound.
falsifier: A lower update exceeds a valid same-cell upper beyond tolerance or originates in a restricted model.

claim: Field service reliability, operational deadlines, market revenue, capacity credit, global AC optimality and security-constrained commitment remain unmeasured.
assumptions: Synthetic service forecasts and static/network-free public benchmark models.
falsifier: Independent field evidence with defensible counterfactuals or exact certificates establishes the corresponding claim.
